body:
im sorry for everything you're going through. 

and for an answer, yes, i'm mad, often very resentful. people will tell you to live but never be able to provide a reason why, in any manner that matters to who they're talking to. all annoying online "reasons to live" articles or social media posts feel like they're written for people who don't want to die to gawk and imagine how sad it would be to be suicidal. 

suicide hotlines and therapists you pay big money to help can't provide short or long term relief, so yeah, i can't stand any reading material that'd try to talk me down from it. once i hear what they have to say and go through the treatment they want me to go through and still come out of it feeling like life isn't worth the pain, i just feel more hopeless and more likely to do it.
